earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: 14% increase in third quarter diluted earnings per share to $0.97
Operating income for the third quarter increased 13% to $1.10 billion (or 21.4% of sales) from $976 million (or 20.7% of sales) for the same period one year ago.
Third quarter comparable store sales growth of 7.2%
Sales for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, increased $416 million, or 9%, to $5.12 billion from $4.71 billion for the same period one year ago.
Gross profit for the third quarter increased 10% to $2.68 billion (or 52.4% of sales) from $2.44 billion (or 51.9% of sales) for the same period one year ago.
